transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… I’m here because I’ve been having some thoughts that scare me. Like… sometimes I think it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And driving home, I catch myself wondering if my family… or my students… might be better off without me. I don’t want to act on it, but it frightened me enough to come in.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things the way you used to, like hobbies or time with family and friends?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to look forward to things like softball, book club, working in my garden… even robotics club at school. Lately I either cancel or just show up and sort of… get through it. It doesn’t really feel enjoyable anymore.
Do you find that these low moods or lack of enjoyment happen most of the day, nearly every day, even when there’s no clear reason for it?

Yeah… most days, I think. It’s not always because of anything specific. I just… don’t really feel much from things I used to enjoy. Softball, book club, the garden, robotics club… I either cancel or I’m just there, going through the motions.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, appetite, energy levels, or concentration lately?

Sleep, mostly. I’ll be exhausted, but then I’m just lying there… replaying assessment deadlines, little mistakes I made in class. And then I wake up around 4 a.m. and I don’t really get back to sleep after that.
Have you completely lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, or do you still try to participate even if you’re not getting much out of them?

I still try sometimes… like I’ll go to book club or softball if I can make myself. But honestly, it’s mostly just going through the motions. A lot of the time I cancel. Even the garden and robotics club don’t really feel enjoyable anymore.

Have you experienced any days where you felt a complete loss of pleasure in all activities, or have you had any periods where you felt slowed down, restless, or had trouble concentrating almost every day?

Yeah… concentrating has been hard. I’ll read the same student response three or four times and still not really know what score to give it. Even small decisions, like which lab supplies to order, can… stall me for way longer than they should.

Have you had any periods where you felt completely unable to feel pleasure in anything at all, or where you felt so slowed down that even small tasks felt impossible, or unusually restless and agitated?

Yeah… I don’t know if it’s “completely,” but it feels close. I used to look forward to softball, book club, working in the garden, robotics club… and now I either cancel or I’m there but not really… enjoying it. Just sort of getting through it.
Have you had days where nothing — absolutely nothing — felt pleasurable, not even things you’ve always enjoyed, like seeing your favorite students or working in your garden?

Yeah… there have been days like that. I mean, I used to look forward to softball, book club, the garden, robotics club… and now it’s like I either cancel or I show up and just… go through the motions. None of it really feels enjoyable anymore.
Have you had any days where absolutely nothing — even things you’ve always enjoyed, like seeing your favorite students or working in your garden — felt pleasurable at all?

Yeah… I think so. I’ve kind of said it already, but things I used to look forward to — softball, book club, the garden, robotics club — I mostly just cancel now, or I’m there and… not really feeling anything from it. It just doesn’t feel enjoyable.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where absolutely nothing gave you pleasure at all — even things you’ve always enjoyed, like seeing your favorite students or working in your garden?

Yeah… for at least that long, I think. Stuff I used to actually look forward to — softball, book club, my garden, robotics club — it’s just… not enjoyable now. I either cancel or show up and kind of go through the motions.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where absolutely nothing — even things you’ve always enjoyed — felt pleasurable at all?

Yeah… I think so. For a couple weeks or more, even the things I used to look forward to—softball, book club, my garden, robotics club—I’ve mostly just canceled, or gone and felt like I was just… there. Not really enjoying any of it.

Yeah… I think so. I know I’ve said it a few times, but it’s like softball, book club, the garden, robotics club… I used to enjoy those, and now I either cancel or just go through the motions. It doesn’t really feel good anymore.
